en: The front side of the postcard displays an old photograph of two large residential-style buildings surrounded by trees and an open yard, likely situated in a rural area. There is Swedish text at the top of the image reading 'Fränsta, Rektorsbostaden vid Folkhögskolan', identifying the location as the Rector's residence at the Folk High School in Fränsta. The back side features handwritten text in Swedish, address lines, a 10 öre Swedish postage stamp depicting a lion, and a visible postmark.
